conformanceVsPreference.reading: conformance and preference are unrelated here. The gate enforces conformance and nothing more, which is the ceiling on every claim made from the primary metric
conformanceVsPreference.caveat: Descriptive, not a test. Eight arms give a correlation with an interval too wide to reject anything; the decision-relevant output of this round is the floor-anchor check and the sign.
